sections.title: Tax on business income of Offshore Banking Units or International Financial Services Centre unit.
sections.text: Where the total income of an assessee includes income of the nature referred to in section 147(3), the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be the aggregate of income-tax computed on the income specified in column B of the Table below at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in column C of the said Table:

table.title: TABLE

rows.column_A: Total income as reduced by income referred to in Sl. No. (1)

table.linearized_text: Section (218): Where the total income of an assessee includes income of the nature referred to in section 147(3), the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be the aggregate of income-tax computed on the income specified in column B of the Table below at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in column C of the said Table: Table items: Item 1 — Sl. No. Income A B: Income referred to in section 147(3); Rate of income-tax payable C: 15%. Item 2 — Sl. No. Income A B: Total income as reduced by income referred to in Sl. No. (1); Rate of income-tax payable C: Rates in force.].
